title: Commission approves €30 million Portuguese State aid for agricultural, fishery and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel and fertiliser prices
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 02 Sep 2026 The European Commission has approved a €30 million State aid scheme for agricultural, fishery and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel and fertiliser prices due to the Middle East crisis.

title: Commission approves German capacity mechanism of up to €35 billion to secure electricity supply
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 02 Sep 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a capacity mechanism for Germany available from 2031. This measure, with an estimated cost between €15.6 billion and €35.2 billion, aims to ensure sufficient capacity to produce, store or flexibly consume electricity, so that electricity production can consistently meet expected demand.

title: Commission approves €400 million German State aid to enhance insulin supply resilience
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 08 Sep 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €400 million German measure in favour of Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH ('Sanofi') to strengthen the resilience of the supply of human insulin and insulin analogues ('insulins'). Under the measure, Germany will pay Sanofi a public service compensation to provide a service of general economic interest ('SGEI').

title: Commission approves €6.1 billion to support Ukraine's air and missile defence and other defence needs
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 11 Sep 2026 Today, the European Commission has approved an additional €6.1 billion for Ukraine to procure different defence products in the field of air and missile defence, ammunition, drones and electronic warfare.
